scope: Bounded public terminology lookup of four SKS codes and five current WHO ATC codes; no user data searched and no application files edited.

SKS.publisher: Sundhedsdatastyrelsen; public SKS browser at medinfo.dk
SKS.scope: Current valid SKS codes only. The browser publishes full Danish labels; historical validity intervals were not obtained.
SKS.verification_method: Direct SKS-code searches in the public browser, read from rendered accessibility results; exact-code row distinguished from ancestors and descendants.
SKS.source_url_caveat: Detail URLs were taken from the rendered official browser links. The web text tool could not fetch those detail URLs, but direct browser search results verified each code and label. Numeric node identifiers belong to the current browser database.

WHO_ATC.publisher: WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology, Norwegian Institute of Public Health
WHO_ATC.scope: Current online 2026 ATC/DDD Index. Historical replacement dates and predecessor-code equivalence were not verified.
WHO_ATC.verification_method: WHO index code/group pages; Danish ingredient spelling independently corroborated in current medinfo SKS M-prefixed ATC rows.

integration_findings: Remove APAA4 as an imaging/CT code trigger and as a CT example; the verified code is a personnel category.
UXCD10, UXCD15 and UXCA00 can carry CT labels only through exact SKS code matching in an appropriate procedure-code source.
All five requested WHO replacement-code labels are verified current, but this lookup does not establish the historical replacement relationship or effective dates.
